consequence.statement: Adding an optional field to the ClusterIssuer schema does not break existing resources; the new field is available for use but not required.

original.statement: The field spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID is added to the cert-manager.io/v1 ClusterIssuer schema.

decision.reason: The CRD artifacts for the two releases [ev-84061d76ea1b] and [ev-60054fcf0986] show that spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID is a new field in the cert-manager.io/v1 ClusterIssuer schema. The deterministic validators confirmed this, and canonical:added/none confirmed that a newly added field has no consequence for existing environments. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. So "none" (informational) is the right consequence.
